**Job Description**

* Review and document change requests, managing the approval process and ensuring proper risk assessment and mitigation strategies are in place.
* Manage change requests for various Biz units, prioritizing them based on impact and urgency, ensuring alignment with business priorities.
* Communicate scheduled blackout/freeze periods to ensure proper risk mitigation during high\-priority times
* Generate change advisory board (CAB) meeting agenda
* Facilitate CAB meetings, manage follow\-up items, and document CAB meeting minutes
* Attend daily change review meetings,
* Attend weekly meetings to review their changes.
* Send out daily major change communication.
* Review Knowledge articles and update/modify as needed
* Provide change management training as needed.
* Generate change Management KPIs/SLAs
* Should be well versed in ITSM reporting
